Play.metaDescription: A small collection of mono-typography mini-games — Mägi Bird and 2048.
Play.heading: Mini-games
Play.subhead: A short distraction. Mono-typography, no ads, no tracking. Best scores are saved to this browser.

notes.privacy: No tracking. No ads. Best scores live in your browser only.
notes.credits: Inspired by 2048 by Gabriele Cirulli (MIT), Snake from the 1970s arcade era, and the tap-to-flap arcade tradition. Original implementation, MIT licensed.

magibird.cardDescription: Tap to flap, dodge the pipes. Reaction-based action.
magibird.metaDescription: Mägi Bird — a mono-typography flap-and-dodge mini-game.
magibird.heading: Mägi Bird
magibird.subhead: Tap, click, or press space to flap. Best score is saved to this browser.
magibird.pressToStart: Press space or tap to start
magibird.controlsHint: Space · Click · Tap · R to restart

g2049.cardDescription: Slide tiles, combine numbers, double your way up. Pure logic.
g2049.metaDescription: A mono-typography number-merge puzzle — slide tiles, combine pairs, double your way up.
g2049.subhead: Slide tiles with arrows, WASD, or swipe. Combine matching numbers and double your way up. Best score is saved to this browser.
g2049.controlsHint: Arrows · WASD · Swipe · R to restart

snake.cardDescription: Eat. Grow. Don't bite yourself. The classic, mono.
snake.metaDescription: A mono-typography Snake — eat the dots, grow the line, avoid yourself.
snake.heading: Snake
snake.subhead: Steer with arrows, WASD, or swipe. Eat the dot to grow. Speed creeps up with each bite. Best score is saved to this browser.
snake.pressToStart: Press an arrow or swipe to start
snake.controlsHint: Arrows · WASD · Swipe · R to restart

mines.cardDescription: Reveal cells, flag mines, deduce your way through. Pure logic.
mines.metaDescription: A mono-typography minesweeper — reveal safe cells, flag the mines, beat your best time.
mines.heading: Mägi Mines
mines.subhead: Tap to reveal. Long-press or right-click to flag. Use arrow keys + Space to play with keyboard. The first click is always safe. Best time per difficulty is saved to this browser.
mines.controlsHint: Tap / Space reveal · Long-press / right-click / F flag · Arrows navigate · R restart
